alpha.name: alpha (Alpha Centauri, NVIDIA A100)
alpha.warning: Alpha Centauri is no longer covered by vendor support. Faulty GPUs and nodes cannot be replaced, so node configurations may be inhomogeneous (e.g. fewer than 8 GPUs).

alpha-interactive.name: alpha-interactive (Alpha Centauri, interactive/MIG)
alpha-interactive.warning: Interactive partition on the login nodes: at most 1 GPU, 1 CPU and 20 GB RAM per job and a maximum runtime of 12 hours. Intended for small tests and compilation.

capella.name: capella (Capella, NVIDIA H100)
capella.warning: Use /data/cat as working filesystem. 12 of the 154 nodes have 1.5 TiB RAM; Slurm allocates them automatically for jobs requesting more than 768 GiB.

capella-interactive.name: capella-interactive (Capella, interactive/MIG)
capella-interactive.warning: Interactive partition on the login nodes: at most 1 GPU (1/7 MIG), 1 CPU and 20 GB RAM per job and a maximum runtime of 12 hours. Intended for small tests and compilation.

barnard.name: barnard (Barnard, CPU)
barnard.warning: 90 of the 720 nodes have 1 TiB RAM; Slurm allocates them automatically for jobs requesting more than 512 GiB. Most other nodes have no or very limited local /tmp storage.

julia.name: julia (Julia, SMP)
julia.warning: Single SMP node with 420 usable cores and about 21.8 TiB RAM. Half of the original hardware is reserved for DZA. There is no node-local /tmp; use /data/nvme instead.

romeo.name: romeo (Romeo, CPU)
romeo.warning: Multithreading is disabled by default. Use --hint=multithread or SLURM_HINT=multithread to enable SMT.
